_comment: FFCAL001 parameters for patches/ff_fuel (brief D1, issue #32).
Build the block with:  ./.venv/bin/python3 patches/ff_fuel/ffcal001.py
Every time constant is in PHYSICAL units and the patch converts it with
ff_tick_ms, the real period of the periodic hook (10 ms - C4, issue #44,
re/findings/scheduler.md section 11).  Move the hook to another raster and
this one value follows; nothing is rebuilt.
D2 (issue #38) turned ff_persist_enable on and gave the other four
persistence values their real defaults: EEP_CONF block 8, payload
offset 0, 5 % hysteresis, one commit per 60 s (eeprom.md section 5).
E1 (issue #34) bumped the block to VERSION 2 and APPENDED the ignition
blend: ff_zw_enable (0 - the feature ships disabled), ff_dzw_max, and the
two 8-point axes of ff_dzw_map.  Nothing moved; the checksum followed the
length from +0xE6 to +0x108.  ff_fzw_curve now carries the docs/05 3.4
shape and ff_dzw_map is still all zero, so the shipped file adds no
advance even if ff_zw_enable is set to 1.
E2 (issue #35) bumped the block to VERSION 3 and APPENDED the start
enrichment: ff_st_enable and ff_zwst_enable (both 0 - the feature ships
disabled), ff_fst_max, ff_zwst_max, ff_zwst_tmax, the two 6-point axes of
ff_fst_map and the ff_fzwst_curve start-advance curve.  Nothing moved;
the checksum followed the length from +0x108 to +0x120.  ff_fst_map is
still all 1024 and ff_fzwst_curve all zero, so the shipped file changes
neither the cranking quantity nor the start angle even with both enables
set to 1.  ff_zwst_tmax is 117, the tmst COUNT for 39.75 degC, which is
also the fifth breakpoint of ff_fst_tmst_axis.
CORRECTION 2026-09-17 (E4, #38): ff_persist_offset was 0, which is a
BUG. EEP_CONF block 8 payload +0/+1 is a {block id, version} stamp
that nvm_read_all_blocks (0x06227C) validates against the flash
default table at 0x060458-0x060470; a mismatch discards the block and
reloads the defaults. Storing the ethanol percent at +0 therefore
overwrote the stamp, the value never survived a key cycle, and the
mirror byte read back as 0x08 - a plausible 8 %, not the 0xFF that
means nothing known. The offset is now 2, the first free payload
byte. re/findings/eeprom.md section 10.5.
E5 (issue #36) bumped the block to VERSION 4 and APPENDED the rail
adder: ff_prail_enable (0 - the feature ships disabled), one reserved
alignment byte, ff_prail_max (3000 = 15.0 bar, exactly the headroom
between KFPRSOLHOM 19000 and the KLPRMAX ceiling 22000),
ff_diag_window_ms (1000) and the 17-point ff_prail_curve.  Nothing
moved; the checksum followed the length from +0x120 to +0x14A.
ff_prail_curve is all zero, so the shipped file cannot move the rail
pressure even with ff_prail_enable set to 1 - and no calibration can
push it past the stock KLPRMAX ceiling in any case, because the adder
goes in BEFORE that clamp (re/findings/rail.md section 12.1).  The old
8-byte ff_prail_add table at +0xDC is SUPERSEDED and left unread.
null means 'use the built-in default': the F curve from the docs/05
section 3.3 formula, the f_zw ramp, the two axes taken from the stock
KFZW axis blocks, and the neutral values for the tables that are still
reserved.
